sql: select 'paper' as src, count(*) as rows, count(distinct market_ticker) as markets, count(distinct split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) as series, count(distinct market_ticker) filter (where created_at > now() - interval '1 day') as markets_new_24h from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' union all select 'live', count(*), count(distinct f.market_ticker), count(distinct split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1)), count(distinct f.market_ticker) filter (where f.filled_at > now() - interval '1 day') from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' union all select 'markets_tbl', count(*), count(*) filter (where created_at > now() - interval '1 day'), count(distinct split_part(ticker,'-',1)), count(distinct split_part(ticker,'-',1)) filter (where created_at > now() - interval '1 day') from markets
